BELIEVER-BELIEVER.title: The Believer
BELIEVER-BELIEVER.description:
A devout ascetic who turns suffering into resolve.
Believer converts faith into raw power.
BELIEVER-BELIEVER.goldMonologue: Gold is only a test of faith, not a reward.
BELIEVER-BELIEVER.eventDeathPrevention: My faith is not finished with me yet.
BELIEVER-BELIEVER.cardsModifierDescripti: Believer cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
BELIEVER-BELIEVER.banter.alive.endTurnPi: My turn is done. Have faith.
